subject: Give the fraction head the checkpoint's own aux set by default
description: Decision 7 of the IM-023 amendment (Tobias 2026-11-07: separate PR, root fix + test). scripts/inference_comparison.run_fraction_inference passes aux_channel_names=None straight to the input builder, which falls back to the canonical aux set, while run_inference and run_class_and_fraction_inference resolve the checkpoint's own set (markfukt in R4). validate_against_nfi.py --use-fraction-head without --enable-markfukt therefore fed the fraction head a different stack than the class head. Root fix: run_fraction_inference delegates to run_class_and_fraction_inference, one code path; test; sweep of callers. The frozen 2026-10-27 runs are unaffected (they used the class head from their own image). Review: Tobias (Codex is not back).
